Purchased from An American Place, NYC (Alfred Stieglitz) 
(Source: Weisman Art Museum, 2025)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive (American Art Research Council Questionnaires) indicates, "An American Place/509 Madison Avenue – Room 1710/(S.E. Corner 53rd St. New York)/Oak Leaves, Pink & Grey – 1929 (oil by Georgia O'Keeffe)" [most probably An American Place label with inscription by Stieglitz – not verified]. Whitney Archive indicates, "Sold to University of Minnesota Gallery." Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Note: Bought from A.S. in 1936." Pictured in 1930 New York (An American Place) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 37. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: Oak Leaves, Pink and Grey

credit_line: Collection of Weisman Art Museum at the University of Minnesota, Minneapolis. Museum Purchase. 1936.85
description: Two large oak leaves overlap against a greenish blue background, both extending beyond the edges of the canvas. The top leaf is painted in a series of pale pink, red, and brown gradients. The bottom leaf is reddish brown with pale pink veins.
title: Oak Leaves, Pink and Grey
